description: Shares the channels of one polyphonic signal out over up to four polyphonic outputs, with the split points chosen by button

params.text: Makes that channel number a split point, so the channels under it leave on one output and the channels from it upward on the next; it dims while it is being ignored

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal whose channels are shared out, its channel count shown on the blue lamps

outputs.text: Carries one run of channels from the input, between one split point and the next; with no split points chosen at all, every channel goes to the first output
